info.name: Partner Onboarding APIs
info.description:
This collection lets a **partner** register and onboard merchants programmatically, then run sample payment operations against the merchants it onboards.

## 🎯 Usage Flow

1. **Auth & Keys**: log in as a partner, then create (or retrieve) a partner API key and, optionally, your HMAC secret.
2. **Onboarding Flow**: register a merchant, fetch the onboarding schema for the current step, submit it, and repeat until `Partner Merchant Inquiry` reports the merchant is approved.
3. **Post-Onboarding Sample Requests**: once a merchant has a `public_key`, charge it using the standard Intention API and inspect/void/refund/capture the resulting transactions.

## 🌍 Base URL

This collection reuses the same `base_url` variable and regional environments as the Accept collections in this repository:

| Country | Base URL | Environment |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Egypt | https://accept.paymob.com | `EGY` |
| Saudi Arabia | https://ksa.paymob.com | `KSA` |
| United Arab Emirates | https://uae.paymob.com | `UAE` |
| Oman | https://oman.paymob.com | `OMN` |

request.description:
## 🔐 Partner Login

Authenticates a partner account and returns a bearer token used by the next step (Create Partner Api Key) and by the HMAC secret lookup.

---

## 📦 Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | String | Yes | The partner account username issued to you by Paymob. |
| `password` | String | Yes | The partner account password issued to you by Paymob. |

---

## 📥 Response

``` json
{
  "profile": {
    "id": 17,
    "company_name": "Your Company",
    "onboarding_partner": {
      "name": "your_partner_code"
    }
  },
  "token": "<bearer_token>",
  "profile_token": "<profile_token>"
}
```

The response's `token` is captured automatically into `{{auth_token}}` by this request's test script - you don't need to copy it manually.

---

## ⚠️ Important Notes

- This is a **partner-level** login, separate from a merchant's own dashboard login.
- Use the resulting `auth_token` as `Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}}` on Create/Retrieve Partner Api Key and Retrieve Partner HMAC Secret.

**Error Codes:**

- 401 Unauthorized: invalid username or password.

request.description:
## 🔑 Create Partner Api Key

Creates a new partner API key. This key (`X-Partner-Api-Key`) is what authenticates every request in the **Onboarding Flow** folder - it is a separate credential from the `auth_token` bearer token used above.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

Requires the bearer token from **Login**: `Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}}`.

---

## 📦 Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | String | Yes | A label for this key, so you can tell multiple keys apart later. |

---

## 📥 Response

``` json
{
  "id": 26,
  "api_key": "<partner_api_key>",
  "name": "My Key"
}
```

The response's `api_key` is captured automatically into `{{api_key}}` by this request's test script.

## 🔑 Retrieve Partner Api Key(s)

Looks up the partner API key(s) already created for this partner account, instead of creating a new one.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

Requires the bearer token from **Login**: `Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}}`.

---

## 📥 Response

``` json
{
  "id": 26,
  "api_key": "<partner_api_key>",
  "name": "My Key"
}
```

## 🔐 Retrieve Partner HMAC Secret

Returns the HMAC secret tied to this partner account, used to verify the authenticity of callbacks/webhooks sent to your `notification_url`.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

Requires the bearer token from **Login**: `Authorization: Bearer {{auth_token}}`.

---

## 📥 Response

``` json
{
  "hmac_secret": "<hmac_secret>"
}
```

request.description:
## 🆕 Register a Merchant

Creates a new merchant under your partner account. This is the first step of the onboarding flow - the returned `merchant_id` is used by every request below.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

Header `X-Partner-Api-Key: {{api_key}}` (from the Auth & Keys folder). No bearer token needed here.

---

## 📦 Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `phone_number` | String | Yes | Merchant contact's phone number, without the country code. |
| `phone_country_code` | String | Yes | Country code for `phone_number`, e.g. `+966`. |
| `full_name` | String | Yes | Merchant contact's full name. |
| `email` | String | Yes | Merchant contact's email address. |
| `send_pass_to_merchant` | Boolean | No | Whether Paymob emails the merchant their dashboard password directly. |

---

## 📥 Response

``` json
{
  "message": "Merchant Created Successfully.",
  "phone_number": "504090379",
  "country_code": "SAU",
  "phone_country_code": "+966",
  "merchant_id": 230458
}
```

The response's `merchant_id` is captured automatically into `{{merchant_id}}`.

request.description:
## 📄 Get Onboarding Schema

Returns the current onboarding step the merchant needs to complete, including its form field definitions - the schema drives Submit Onboarding Step below.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

Header `X-Partner-Api-Key: {{api_key}}`.

---

## 🔍 Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `partner` | String | Yes | Your partner code, as assigned by Paymob when your integration was set up. |
| `resubmission` | Boolean | No | Set to `true` when the merchant is correcting a previously rejected step. |
| `paymob_mid` | Integer | Yes | The `merchant_id` returned by Register a Merchant. |

---

## 📥 Response (abridged)

``` json
{
  "schema_id": "<schema_id>",
  "flow_title": "Flow External",
  "partner": "{{partner_name}}",
  "step_count": 2,
  "step": {
    "step_id": "<step_id>",
    "step_title": "...",
    "fields": [ ]
  }
}
```

The response's `schema_id` and `step.step_id` are captured into `{{schema_id}}` and `{{step_id}}` for use in Submit Onboarding Step.

request.description:
## ✅ Submit Onboarding Step

Submits the merchant's answers for the current onboarding step. Field keys (`field_text_...`, `field_file_...`, `field_array_...`) come directly from the `fields` array returned by Get Onboarding Schema for that step - they are schema-specific and will differ between partners, flows, and steps.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

Header `X-Partner-Api-Key: {{api_key}}`.

---

## 🔍 Path & Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_id` (path) | String | Yes | From Get Onboarding Schema's `schema_id`. |
| `step_id` (path) | String | Yes | From Get Onboarding Schema's `step.step_id`. |
| `resubmission` | Boolean | No | Set to `true` when correcting a previously rejected step. |
| `paymob_mid` | Integer | Yes | The `merchant_id` returned by Register a Merchant. |

---

## 📦 Request Body (Form-Data)

One form-data entry per field defined by the schema for this step. Text fields are sent as plain text; array-type fields as a JSON-encoded string (e.g. `["1"]`); file fields as file uploads.

---

## 📥 Response (abridged)

``` json
{
  "message": "step submitted successfully",
  "type": "terms_and_conditions",
  "schema": {
    "schema_id": "<schema_id>",
    "step_id": "<next_step_id>"
  }
}
```

The next step's `schema_id`/`step_id` are captured automatically, so calling **Get Onboarding Schema** again (or submitting again) continues the flow until the final step.

request.description:
## 🔎 Partner Merchant Inquiry

Checks a merchant's onboarding progress and legal approval status. Call this periodically to track progress, and watch for `legal_status` changing to `Approved`.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

Header `X-Partner-Api-Key: {{api_key}}`.

---

## 🔍 Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `paymob_mid` | Integer | Yes | The `merchant_id` returned by Register a Merchant. |

---

## 📥 Response

``` json
{
  "id": 229648,
  "onboarding_status": "Final Page",
  "legal_status": "Approved",
  "public_key": "<merchant_public_key>",
  "live_integrations": [
    { "id": 5740, "service_name": "MIGS-online (NEXT)" }
  ],
  "required_for_resubmission": {}
}
```

### Key Response Fields

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `onboarding_status` | Where the merchant is in the onboarding flow (e.g. a step name, or `Final Page` once finished). |
| `legal_status` | Approval state of the merchant's submitted documents (e.g. `Approved`, `Pending`, `Rejected`). |
| `public_key` | The merchant's live public key, once approved - used to build Unified Checkout redirects. Captured into `{{merchant_public_key}}`. |
| `required_for_resubmission` | Populated with the fields that need correcting when `legal_status` requires a resubmission. |

request.description:
## 💳 Create Payment Intention (Sample)

A sample charge made on behalf of the merchant created earlier, using the standard Intention API (see the **Intention APIs** collection for the full reference) with the added `partner_api_key`/`paymob_mid` query parameters so it runs against a partner-managed merchant.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

No Authorization header - authenticated via the `partner_api_key` and `paymob_mid` query parameters below, same as the other Post-Onboarding requests.

---

## 🔍 Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `partner_api_key` | String | Yes | Your partner API key from the Auth & Keys folder. |
| `paymob_mid` | Integer | Yes | The merchant to charge. |

---

## 📥 Response (abridged)

``` json
{
  "payment_keys": [ { "integration": 5740, "key": "<payment_key>", "order_id": 959429 } ],
  "client_secret": "<client_secret>",
  "id": "<intention_id>"
}
```

The test script builds the Unified Checkout redirect URL from `client_secret` and `{{merchant_public_key}}` (captured earlier by Partner Merchant Inquiry) and logs it to the Postman console.

## ❌ Void Transaction

Instantly cancels a same-day "Authorize-only" or captured transaction using `transaction_id`, avoiding the fees a full refund would incur.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

No Authorization header - authenticated via the `partner_api_key` and `paymob_mid` query parameters.

## 🔍 Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `partner_api_key` | String | Yes | Your partner API key. |
| `paymob_mid` | Integer | Yes | The merchant the transaction belongs to. |

---

## 📦 Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transaction_id` | String | Yes | The transaction to void. |

## ↩️ Refund Transaction

Fully or partially reverses a captured transaction using `transaction_id` and the amount (in cents) to refund.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

No Authorization header - authenticated via the `partner_api_key` and `paymob_mid` query parameters.

## 🔍 Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `partner_api_key` | String | Yes | Your partner API key. |
| `paymob_mid` | Integer | Yes | The merchant the transaction belongs to. |

---

## 📦 Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transaction_id` | String | Yes | The transaction to refund. |
| `amount_cents` | Integer | Yes | Amount to refund, in cents. Use the full original amount for a full refund, or less for a partial refund. |

## ✅ Capture Transaction

Finalizes an "Authorize-only" transaction for the given amount. Amounts not captured within 14 days are automatically voided.

---

## 🔐 Authentication

No Authorization header - authenticated via the `partner_api_key` and `paymob_mid` query parameters.

## 🔍 Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `partner_api_key` | String | Yes | Your partner API key. |
| `paymob_mid` | Integer | Yes | The merchant the transaction belongs to. |

---

## 📦 Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transaction_id` | String | Yes | The authorized transaction to capture. |
| `amount_cents` | Integer | Yes | Amount to capture, in cents. Can be less than or equal to the authorized amount. |

## 🔎 Get Transaction by Transaction ID

Looks up a single transaction's full details using Paymob's own `transaction_id`.

---

## 🔍 Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `partner_api_key` | String | Yes | Your partner API key. |
| `paymob_mid` | Integer | Yes | The merchant the transaction belongs to. |

## 🔎 Get Transaction by Order ID

Looks up transaction details using Paymob's own `order_id` (returned in the Create Payment Intention response as `payment_keys[0].order_id`).

---

## 🔍 Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `partner_api_key` | String | Yes | Your partner API key. |
| `paymob_mid` | Integer | Yes | The merchant the transaction belongs to. |

---

## 📦 Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_id` | String | Yes | Paymob's order ID for the transaction. |

## 🔎 Get Transaction by Special Reference

Looks up transaction details using your own merchant order reference (the `special_reference` you sent when creating the payment intention).

---

## 🔍 Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `partner_api_key` | String | Yes | Your partner API key. |
| `paymob_mid` | Integer | Yes | The merchant the transaction belongs to. |

---

## 📦 Request Body

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `merchant_order_id` | String | Yes | Your own reference value, matching the `special_reference` sent on Create Payment Intention. |
